11.     Current Use of the Property: The subject propertv is currently improved with a vacant five-story

12.     Reason for rezoning the property: The Applicant is seeking to amend the previously approved and
        ratified Type 1 Zoninii Ordinance, in order to revert the zoning for the subject property back to the
        original underlying classification, to allow for the rehabilitation and adaptive reuse of the existing
        five-story 'storage' building and the existing one-story commercial building.

13.     Describe the proposed use of the property after the rezoning. Indicate the number of dwelling unit
        number of parking spaces; approximate square footage of any commercial space; and height ofthe
        proposed building. (BE SPECIFIC) The Applicant is seeking to amend the previously approved
        and ratified Type 1 Zoning Ordinance, in order to revert the zoning for the subject property back to
        the original underlying classification, to allow for the rehabilitation and adaptive reuse of the
        existing five-story 'storage' building and the existing one-story commercial building. Both of the
        existing buildings will be preserved and rehabilitated, in their entirety, to allow for the
        establislmient of new uses therein. The plan also calls for the two buildings to be conjoined at grade
        level. Upon completion, the newly rehabilitated building is intended to contain a daycare facility
        (12,580 square feet) on the conjoined P' Floor, with the 2"'^ and 3'"'' Floors providing open office
        space (4,250 square feet and 4,700 square feet, respectively. There will be nine (9) new dwelling:
        units located on and between the 4''' and 5"^ Floors, which are intended to be prioritized and made
        available for employees and/or tenants of the other non-residential operations in the building on a
        /tve-wo/Vc basis. The rehabilitation proposal also calls for the provision of off-street surface parking
        for nine (9) vehicles, as well as a single loadins berth, along the north side of the building, which
        will be first reserved for the daycare facility and office tenants. The subject property is located on
        a Pedestrian Street, wdthin 2,640 linear feet ofthe entrance to the California CTA Train Station. As
        such, the Applicant will not be providing designated off-street parking for the residential units,
        pursuant to the Transit Served Location (TSL) provisions of the Zoning Ordinance. The existing
        buildings are masonry in construction and measure 64 feet-10 inches (five-story) and 16 feet-0
        inches (one-story) in height, respectively.

14.     The Affordable Requirements Ordinance (ARO) requires on-site affordable housing units and/or
        a financial contribution for residential housing projects with ten or more units that receive a zoning
        change which, among other triggers, increases the allowable floor area, or, for existing Planned
        Developments, increases the number of units (see attached fact sheet or visit
        www.cityofchicago.org/ARO for more information). Is this project subject to the ARO?
